verdict.rationale: Ollama states that prompts are never tracked or trained on, and that nothing run locally leaves the machine. That covers the story by default, with no opt-out needed. The evidence is limited to short homepage marketing claims. missing for 10: detailed first-party privacy policy or contractual data-use terms (especially for Ollama Cloud), independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-training claim

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Your prompts are never tracked or trained on.
Nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine.
